purpose: Prepare for an agentic-AI interview by building an agent hands-on. A training artefact, not a product.

steps.title: Raw OpenAI SDK agent
steps.why: Understand the loop without a framework hiding it: model call, tool dispatch, observation, repeat.

steps.title: Ollama Cloud models, switchable per run
steps.why: Prove the provider boundary is real by switching models without touching agent code.

steps.title: LangChain: the same agent
steps.why: See what the framework hides and what it costs. Compare against the SDK version line by line.

steps.title: LangGraph: the same agent as a graph
steps.why: State, conditional edges, and interrupts for human approval -- the interview-relevant payoff.

steps.title: Evaluation and interview rehearsal
steps.why: Prove the agent works and practise explaining the design aloud.

not_in_plan: Additional guardrails or audit checks beyond section 0 of AGENTS.md
Web UI, trace viewer, or dashboard
